criteria_results.criterion_text: `NATSClient` has `async def publish_episode(self, episode: MemoryEpisodeV1) -> None`
criteria_results.evidence: Implemented publish_episode() method in src/nats_core/client.py with Google-style docstring. Method includes RuntimeError check for disconnected client. Verified by test_publish_episode_raises_runtime_error_when_not_connected.

Method publishes raw MemoryEpisodeV1 JSON directly without MessageEnvelope wrapping. Uses Topics.resolve(Topics.Memory.EPISODE, project_id=..., episode_type=...) for subject construction. Sets Nats-Msg-Id header to episode_id. Verified by test_publish_episode_publishes_raw_json_with_nats_msg_id_header and seam tests.

Implemented size guard that measures full encoded model bytes. Raises ValueError with detailed message including measured size and 900KB limit when exceeded. Publish is not called in this case. Verified by test_publish_episode_rejects_oversized_episode and test_publish_episode_accepts_episode_at_size_limit.

criteria_results.evidence: publish_raw() signature remains (subject: str, data: bytes) with no headers parameter. publish() method is completely untouched. Verified by test_publish_raw_signature_unchanged.
Added import statement: 'from nats_core.events import MAX_EPISODE_BODY_BYTES, MemoryEpisodeV1' to client.py. Verified by test_publish_episode_imports_from_events_module.
